# attested claim

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestedClaim`](gmeow-attestedClaim.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedClaim>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)

The observation or claim that an attestation vouches for, when the subject of the attestation is itself a claim rather than a bare entity. Non-functional: an attestation may vouch for several related claims simultaneously.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) -> [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern
